title: Shoulder pain – no work information
scenario: Genuine gaps. The consultation never mentions the patient's job, the clinician has not written an assessment of work capacity, and the sick-leave extent and period are left blank. The app should ask focused questions and must not invent a job, a causal link or a decision.

sources.speaker: Patient
sources.text: My right shoulder. It's been hurting for about six weeks now, and it's getting worse.

sources.speaker: Patient
sources.text: When I lift my arm above my head. And at night, if I lie on that side, it wakes me up.

sources.speaker: Doctor
sources.text: Have you tried anything for it?

sources.speaker: Patient
sources.text: Ibuprofen now and then. It takes the edge off, but it doesn't last.

sources.speaker: Doctor
sources.text: Any numbness or tingling down the arm?

sources.speaker: Patient
sources.text: Honestly, I'm just fed up. I need a note so I can stay home for a while.

sources.label: Examination findings
sources.text: Painful arc between 70 and 120 degrees of abduction on the right. Hawkins and Neer tests positive on the right. Full passive range of motion. Normal strength.

sources.label: Functional impairment
sources.text: Pain-related reduction in the ability to work with the right arm above shoulder height.

clinician_decisions.diagnosis: Impingement syndrome of the right shoulder (M75.4)

expected_facts.fact: Pain-related reduction in the ability to work with the right arm above shoulder height
Six weeks of worsening pain, worst with overhead movement and at night, no numbness or tingling, stated as patient-reported

forbidden_inferences: A statement that the patient cannot work or has reduced work capacity.
Any sick-leave percentage or duration, including a 'suggested' one.
Treating the patient's request for a note (T9) as the clinician's assessment.

expected_findings.description: Neither the consultation nor the clinician's notes say what the patient's job is or what it involves.
expected_findings.acceptable_question: What is the patient's occupation, and what do their work tasks involve, especially any work with the arms raised above shoulder height?

expected_findings.description: There is no clinician assessment of how the shoulder impairment limits the patient's work.
expected_findings.acceptable_question: How does the reduced ability to work with the right arm above shoulder height affect the patient's specific work tasks?

expected_findings.description: Sick-leave extent and period have not been entered. They must stay empty until the clinician enters them.
expected_findings.acceptable_question: Enter the sick-leave extent and period, if sick leave is being recommended.

must_not_flag: The examination findings and the patient's description, which are correctly separated if the draft follows K1 and T2–T8.
